accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Noida International Airport at Jewar?
o: It is a privately owned airport established exclusively for international cargo
It is a public-private partnership project and a net-zero airport whose Phase 1 was opened by the Prime Minister
It is a wholly government-owned airport and India’s first airport in a Special Economic Zone
It is India’s first railway-linked airport developed under the BOT model
accepted.x: The Noida International Airport at Jewar is being developed as a public-private partnership and is described as a net-zero airport. Its first phase was opened by the Prime Minister.
accepted.tq: Use the project-description combination rather than being distracted by ownership or model swaps.
accepted.sec: National projects inaugurated - infrastructure FIRSTs, river-linking, foreign campuses  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Bairabi-Sairang is Mizoram’s first railway line.
2. Aizawl became the fourth capital in the North-East to be placed on the railway map.
3. Bairabi-Sairang is India’s first major river-linking project.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Bairabi-Sairang is Mizoram’s first railway line, and Aizawl is the fourth North-Eastern capital on the rail map. The first major river-linking project is Ken-Betwa, not Bairabi-Sairang.
accepted.tq: Separate the railway facts from the river-linking fact to identify the wrong statement.
accepted.sec: National projects inaugurated - infrastructure FIRSTs, river-linking, foreign campuses  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper depot is located at:
accepted.x: Bhagat Ki Kothi in Jodhpur is the location of the first Vande Bharat Sleeper depot.
accepted.tq: Test the exact location associated with an infrastructure first.
accepted.sec: National projects inaugurated - infrastructure FIRSTs, river-linking, foreign campuses  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the Ken-Betwa project is correct?
o: It is a net-zero airport project implemented through a public-private partnership.
It is Mizoram’s first railway project and faces protests over land acquisition.
It is the first foreign university campus project in India.
It is India’s first major river-linking project and faces protests relating to displacement.
accepted.x: Ken-Betwa is India’s first major river-linking project, and displacement protests have been associated with it.
accepted.tq: Match the project with its distinctive first and associated issue.
accepted.sec: National projects inaugurated - infrastructure FIRSTs, river-linking, foreign campuses  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Foreign university campuses in India are established under which regulatory framework?
accepted.x: Foreign university campuses are set up under the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2023.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct regulatory authority and year instead of a neighbouring education framework.
accepted.sec: National projects inaugurated - infrastructure FIRSTs, river-linking, foreign campuses  [APPSC]

accepted.s:

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The National Turmeric Board was set up in January 2025.
2. Its headquarters is at Nizamabad in Telangana.

accepted.s: Under PM-KISAN, eligible landholding farmer families receive:
o: ₹6,000 annually in two instalments of ₹3,000 each
₹6,000 annually in three instalments of ₹2,000 each
₹12,000 annually in three instalments of ₹4,000 each
accepted.x: PM-KISAN provides ₹6,000 per year to eligible landholding farmer families in three instalments of ₹2,000 each.
accepted.tq: Break the total benefit into its instalment structure.

accepted.s: Which of the following categories is excluded from PM-KISAN as indicated in the scheme features?
o: Income-tax payers and most government employees
Small and marginal farmers without income-tax liability
Farmer families receiving the benefit through bank accounts
accepted.x: Income-tax payers and most government employees are excluded from PM-KISAN, while the scheme covers eligible landholding farmer families.
accepted.tq: Find the exception by distinguishing the beneficiary group from excluded categories.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes VB-G RAM G?
o: It provides 125 days of work to rural households with an interim base wage of ₹300 per day.
It provides 100 days of work to urban households with a base wage of ₹500 per day.
It provides 150 days of work to farmers with a yearly benefit of ₹6,000.
It provides subsidised LPG connections to adult women in rural households.
accepted.x: VB-G RAM G provides 125 days of work to rural households and specifies an interim base wage of ₹300 per day.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an employment guarantee feature from farmer and LPG benefits.
accepted.sec: Schemes for specific groups - benefit amounts

accepted.s: Under VB-G RAM G, wages are shared between the Centre and States in which ratio?
accepted.x: The wages under VB-G RAM G are shared between the Centre and States in the ratio of 60:40.
accepted.tq: Test the precise fiscal-sharing ratio rather than the number of workdays.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about PM SVANidhi:
1. It is meant for street vendors.
2. It provides a 7% interest subsidy.
3. The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs and the Department of Financial Services are associated with it.
4. SIDBI implements the scheme.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. PM SVANidhi targets street vendors, provides a 7% interest subsidy, involves MoHUA and DFS, and is implemented by SIDBI.
accepted.tq: Verify the beneficiary, subsidy and institutional roles before choosing the all-inclusive code.

Procurement of pulses at minimum support price

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: PMUY — ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly distinguishes PMAY-G from PMAY-U?
o: PMAY-G is implemented by MoHUA, whereas PMAY-U is implemented by Rural Development.
PMAY-G concerns LPG and PMAY-U concerns electricity connections.
PMAY-G is implemented by Rural Development, whereas PMAY-U is implemented by MoHUA.
Both are implemented by the Ministry of Jal Shakti.
accepted.x: PMAY-G is associated with the Ministry of Rural Development, while PMAY-U is associated with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. Both concern pucca housing in rural and urban areas respectively.
accepted.tq: Compare the ministry and rural-urban scope instead of relying on similar abbreviations.

Which of the following statements is correct regarding PM Ujjwala Yojana?
